pages.title: Emergency Starter Home
pages.text: Purchased from any village novice across all professions for $(a)1 Emerald$(0) (just like base companions).$(br2)Right-click 3 times to deploy:$(br)1. Preview chunk bounds$(br)2. Confirm destination$(br)3. Deploy fortified chunk base!

pages.title: Luxury Starter Home
pages.text: Crafted by upgrading an Emergency Starter Home with a Block of Iron, Block of Gold, Block of Diamond, and Block of Emerald in a crafting table.$(br2)Constructs an expansive, fully furnished multi-story compound featuring complete interior amenities, lighting, and storage.
